content:
Anya: Kicking off alignment for the Acme POC — need to lock success criteria, timeline, and resourcing. Quick sync?
Priya: +1. Proposed success criteria: 1) Latency p95 < 400ms for 512 tokens on hosted; 2) Response quality: top-1 accuracy >= 86% on our eval set; 3) Cost target: <$0.0006/token at expected QPS; 4) Security questionnaire completed by end of week 3.
Sam: Copy. Also need deliverables for decision: prompt bank, eval harness + scripts, short runbook for integration.
Marcus: For infra, ask: can we get 2 dev GPUs for load testing? SE support ~0.25 FTE across weeks 1–3. Can the team commit?
Anya: Customer expects a 4-week runway. Can we map milestones to weeks?
Priya: Proposed milestones:
- Week0: kickoff + data collection/SCOPING
- Week1: baseline runs + metric collection
- Week2: tuning + reranker/temperature experiments
- Week3: end-to-end demo + light load run
- Week4: handoff, contract decision window
Jordan: I'll own customer comms and scenario capture. I can provide labeled sample set (≈500 rows) by Tue.
Sam: Pricing question from Acme: hosted trial vs dedicated trial — what's the recommendation for a 4-week POC? @Elena can you weigh in?
Elena: For a short 4-week POC we recommend hosted pay-as-you-go. Dedicated requires a longer commit (min 3 months). Rough hosted ballpark for expected footprint: $5k–$12k depending on traffic and embedding usage.
Marcus: Potential blocker: Acme listed SCIM + data residency as requirements. Private deployment could be 6–8 weeks; need confirmation of must-haves for POC vs procurement.
Priya: For POC we can accept SAML SSO and route inference through EU region for residency. SCIM can be deferred to post-POC if they agree.
Anya: Action checklist to share with the customer. @Priya can you drop prompts + eval harness by EOD Fri?
Priya: Yes — I'll deliver: prompt bank (~30 prompts), eval harness + runner, baseline metrics, and example run command:
```
python eval.py --model redwood-hosted-v1 --input eval.json --out results.json
```
Sam: Can we schedule a weekly 30-min war-room? Wed 11:00 AM PT works for me.
Jordan: Wed 11:00 PT works. I'll invite the Acme PM and technical lead.
deploy-bot: Meeting created: Wed 11:00 PT — "POC Weekly Sync" (calendar link) :calendar:
Anya: Great. Final action items: Priya — artifacts by Fri. Marcus — confirm GPU/dev environment availability by Tue. Elena — provide hosted vs dedicated estimate by Wed. Jordan — confirm sample data delivery on Tue. I'll follow up with the customer after artifacts are posted.
Priya: Noted. Planning 3 short prompt-tuning sessions (30m each) during Week2.
Marcus: Metrics we'll capture: p95 latency, throughput (req/s), token cost per 1M tokens, and quality metrics (accuracy/F1). Add adversarial/evasion checks to eval set.
Anya: Thanks team — closing thread for now. I'll post the summary to the customer after Wed's sync. :thumbsup:
